theme: An open Sunday in Maine, the girls with Jen.
greeting: Nothing's on the calendar today, Dan — a rare wide-open Sunday. The girls are with Jen this week, so the quiet is yours to spend.

needsAttention.title: Pick a time with Eugenia
needsAttention.detail: In the PRI thread, Eugenia offered Monday noon–2 or Thursday morning your time and is waiting on you to choose — a reply today is what makes tomorrow's call happen.

needsAttention.title: Confirm Mike's pre-op details
needsAttention.detail: Your Personal Tasks prep list wants the surgeon's pre-op instructions confirmed by tomorrow, ahead of Mike's Aug 20 oral surgery in Portland. The task is two days overdue.

flagged.title: Valoris circling back on StePs
flagged.detail: Marc followed up on your idea to widen the IMC conversation beyond asset managers; you're cc'd with Chie, no direct ask to you yet.

flagged.title: Talkiatry follow-up Tuesday
flagged.detail: Virtual visit with Dr. Snowden on Tuesday, Aug 18 at 10 AM ET.

flagged.title: Morgan Stanley proxy notice
flagged.detail: Proxy materials posted for one of your holdings — informational, votable whenever you're ready.

inbox.noise: The New Yorker Daily, NYT Cooking's weeknight dinners, and a chatty nudge from your realtor.
inbox.clear: Nothing else in the inbox is pulling at you this morning.

recipe.title: Olive oil–poached zucchini & raw tomatoes
recipe.why: Peak-summer zucchini and just-picked tomatoes, softened slowly in good olive oil — exactly the unhurried supper a quiet Maine evening is asking for.

acts.line: A clear Sunday morning with the girls at Jen's — the house and the hours are your own.
Nothing scheduled straight through; the longest open runway you've had all week.
Quiet into the evening, with Monday holding a midday call to lock in and a birthday to note.
